#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o app .

package calc

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name, in, want string
	}{
		{"spec example", "1 + 2 * 3
-7 / 2
(1 + 2
9223372036854775807 + 1
", "7
-3
error
error
"},
		{"blank lines", "
  42  
	
1+1", "42
2
"},
		{"remainder sign", "-7 % 3
7 % -3
", "-1
1
"},
		{"division by zero", "1 / 0
5 % 0
", "error
error
"},
		{"min int", "-9223372036854775807 - 1
(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1
", "-9223372036854775808
0
"},
		{"literal overflow", "-9223372036854775808
", "error
"},
		{"op overflow", "(-9223372036854775807-1) / -1
(-9223372036854775807-1) * -1
-(-9223372036854775807-1)
3037000500*3037000500
", "error
error
error
error
"},
		{"unary chains", "--5
1 - -2
- - -3
", "5
3
-3
"},
		{"syntax", "1 +
abc
()
1 2
+1
1
", "error
error
error
error
error
error
"},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var out strings.Builder
			if err := Run(strings.NewReader(tt.in), &out); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("Run: %v", err)
			}
			if got := out.String(); got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("got %q, want %q", got, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

package lru

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name, in, want string
	}{
		{"spec example", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
SET c 3
GET b
SIZE
", "1
NULL
2
"},
		{"overwrite refreshes", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
SET a 9
SET c 3
GET a
GET b
GET c
", "9
NULL
3
"},
		{"del and size", "3
SET x 1
DEL x
DEL x
SIZE
GET x
", "1
0
0
NULL
"},
		{"capacity one", "1
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
GET b
SIZE", "NULL
2
1
"},
		{"get refreshes", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
SET c 3
GET a
GET b
", "1
1
NULL
"},
		{"slot reuse after delete", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
DEL a
SET c 3
SET d 4
GET b
GET c
GET d
SIZE
", "1
NULL
3
4
2
"},
		{"empty input", "", ""},
		{"no commands", "5
", ""},
		{"crlf", "1
SET a 1
GET a
", "1
"},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var out strings.Builder
			if err := Run(strings.NewReader(tt.in), &out); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("Run: %v", err)
			}
			if got := out.String(); got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("output = %q, want %q", got, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestRunInvalidCapacity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, in := range []string{"0
", "abc
", "1000001
"} {
		if err := Run(strings.NewReader(in), &strings.Builder{}); err == nil {
			t.Errorf("Run(%q): expected error", in)
		}
	}
}
